talking-to-olaf-if-the-fremennik-trials-.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-if-the-fremennik-trials-.text: Get lost, outlander! I've no time for you!

talking-to-olaf-if-the-fremennik-trials-.player: It's me, [player name]. What are you doing out here?

talking-to-olaf-if-the-fremennik-trials-.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-if-the-fremennik-trials-.text: Nothing... Just carving these horribly broken pieces of driftwood.

talking-to-olaf-if-the-fremennik-trials-.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-if-the-fremennik-trials-.text: Wait! Would you do me a favour?

talking-to-olaf-if-the-fremennik-trials-.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-if-the-fremennik-trials-.text: Look, you see that heap of driftwood over there? That is my ship, and all that is left of my one shot at making my ancestors proud of me.

talking-to-olaf-if-the-fremennik-trials-.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-if-the-fremennik-trials-.text: My family have always been great explorers and seafarers, and I recently set off on my maiden voyage.

talking-to-olaf-if-the-fremennik-trials-.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-if-the-fremennik-trials-.text: However, a big storm - yes, a huge storm in fact - blew my ship onto the rocks. Three times.

talking-to-olaf-if-the-fremennik-trials-.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-if-the-fremennik-trials-.text: I've been sitting here ever since, trying to think of a way to make my family proud, and if you will help me...I think I have a way.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Thank you! I don't have much apart from my carvings, some driftwood and the map that I was following when I had my little...

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: ...accident.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: If you help me out, then I'll gladly hand it over.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Well, I have a little food left, although it's a little briny.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: If you take a couple of carvings to my wife and son in the village over the hill and tell them that I sent you with them from a distant island, then I can wait out here for a week or so before returning.

steps.player: Alright, hand me over the carvings and I'll be on my way.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Well, none of these are any good. I'll need some fresh wood from a decent tree.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: When I was swimming for my life I saw an odd-looking windswept tree to the east of here, up that cliff.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Could you bring me some of that wood so I can work it?

steps.player: Wow, you must have pretty good eyes to be able to see a single tree from the water during a heavy storm.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Yes...great eyes...they run in the family.

steps.player: Possibly later, when you don't smell so damp.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Bah! Well, if you aren't going to help, do me a favour and jump off that cliff!

talking-to-olaf-talking-to-olaf-again-wi.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-talking-to-olaf-again-wi.text: So... Got the logs for me yet?

talking-to-olaf-talking-to-olaf-again-wi.player: Not yet. I just popped back to see how you were doing.

talking-to-olaf-talking-to-olaf-again-wi.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-talking-to-olaf-again-wi.text: Still cold. Still damp. 'Bout average, really.

talking-to-olaf-talking-to-olaf-with-the.player: Olaf, I cut some logs from the tree. Here's the wood.

talking-to-olaf-talking-to-olaf-with-the.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-talking-to-olaf-with-the.text: Wonderful! I'll carve them up now.

talking-to-olaf-talking-to-olaf-with-the.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-talking-to-olaf-with-the.text: This is for my wife, Ingrid. I'm sure she will love it. Tell her it's tribal or something.

talking-to-olaf-talking-to-olaf-with-the.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-talking-to-olaf-with-the.text: And this one is for my son, Volf. Kids love planks in my experience. Tell him I said hello.

talking-to-olaf-talking-to-olaf-with-the.player: Alright. They live in Rellekka, right?

talking-to-olaf-talking-to-olaf-with-the.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-talking-to-olaf-with-the.text: Yes. Hurry back! And don't forget the story: I'm not here, I'm someplace far away.

delivering-the-presents-talking-to-olaf-.speaker: Olaf Hradson
delivering-the-presents-talking-to-olaf-.text: So, how did my wife like her carving?
If Ingrid's present has not been delivered yet:

steps.player: I don't know... I've still got it.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Well, hurry up and give it to her then!

delivering-the-presents-talking-to-olaf-.text: If Ingrid's present has been delivered:

steps.player: She was very happy with it!

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Wonderful!

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: I wish i could see her again...

steps.player: Well, if this plan works out you will be able too, right?

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Yes, you're right.

delivering-the-presents-talking-to-olaf-.text: If Volf's present has not been delivered yet:

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Did my son like his present? I'll bet he was thrilled.

steps.player: I'll bet he will be... but I've still got it.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Well, take your time over it, why don't you.

delivering-the-presents-talking-to-olaf-.text: If Volf's present has been delivered:

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Did my son like his present? I'll bet he was thrilled.

steps.player: Yes, he was thrilled with it!

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: I'll bet he's grown since I left, those many, many, many...hours ago.

steps.player: That's doubtful, unless magic is involved.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: You have a good point. I can't wait to get back.

delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.player: Excuse me, but are you Ingrid? The same Ingrid that is married to Olaf Hradson?

delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.speaker: Ingrid Hradson
delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.text: Yes I am. Why do you ask?

delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.player: I am a friend of your husband. He sent me here with a gift for you.
An expensive, exotic gift from the far-flung and tropical shores of the Island of Obscurity.

delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.speaker: Ingrid Hradson
delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.text: How wonderful! I assumed from the way the big oaf always referred to the rigging as 'big strings' that he couldn't navigate his way out of a soggy paper bag. So, can I see the gift he sent?

delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.player: Certainly! Here it is. He sends his best wishes along with it.

delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.speaker: Ingrid Hradson
delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.text: I see. It looks like a log with 'Olaf was here' carved in it.

delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.player: It's tribal! Very tribal! I watched the natives carve it myself.

delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.speaker: Ingrid Hradson
delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.text: Well, since you have come such a long way, you can have this. I baked it this morning, so it's still nice and fresh.

delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.player: Oh, thank you! Enjoy your Obscurian Tribal Artefact(tm). It has a million-and-one uses!

delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.speaker: Ingrid Hradson
delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.text: Hello again! Have you any word from my husband?

delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.player: Err, no, not yet. It takes a while for the messages to reach me, you know.

delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.speaker: Ingrid Hradson
delivering-the-presents-ingrid-s-present.text: Well, when you do, tell him we'll be more than happy to see him again.

delivering-the-presents-volf-s-present.player: No, but I do know your father. He sent me with a present for you from, err...

delivering-the-presents-volf-s-present.speaker: Volf Olafson
delivering-the-presents-volf-s-present.text: Oh! That was fast! He only set off recently, and I was wondering how he was doing. So, where is this gift?

delivering-the-presents-volf-s-present.player: Very valuable. Have a nice time!

delivering-the-presents-volf-s-present.speaker: Volf Olafson
delivering-the-presents-volf-s-present.text: Wait! Here, take this. I was going to have it for my lunch, but I suppose you can have it in payment.

delivering-the-presents-volf-s-present-t.speaker: Volf Olafson
delivering-the-presents-volf-s-present-t.text: Hello again! Does my father send any word...or treasures like before?

delivering-the-presents-volf-s-present-t.player: Not today, but if he does, you will be the first to know.

talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.player: I delivered your carvings as you asked. Your family would like to see you again.
Here, let me get you to the village before you freeze to death.

talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.text: I won't...go...anywhere. I don't...care if I...freeze.

talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.player: Well, at least give me the map like you promised!

talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.text: So...very...cold. Almost cold enough to tear up an old map with my fevered shivering. Cough, cough.
You managed to get the fire going!

talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.player: Well, I'm glad you're happy. Can I have that map now?

talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.text: Well, okay...but could I have a little of that food first? I've had nothing but seaweed and biscuits for the past week.

options.text: Alright, here, have some food. Now give me the map.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Oh... That was a banquet compared to the stuff I've been living off.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Look, I have a bit of a confession. I think that the map may well be cursed.

steps.player: What? All this running about for a cursed map! Couldn't you have made this little revelation before I fed you?

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Look, I'm sorry, okay. Remember that I followed this map and ended up on the rocks.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: It may be nothing, after all, but I think you should be very careful if you go looking for the treasure.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Well, regardless, you've more than earned this map. It was the last one my grandfather, Sven the Helmsman, ever made.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Okay, okay, I was only asking.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: Well, regardless, you've more than earned this map. It was the last one my grandfather, Sven the Helmsman, ever made.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: It is supposed to show the location of one of his stashes of treasure, but I have never been able to decipher the strange, runic inscriptions that point the way.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: I wish you luck!

steps.player: Well, thanks. What will you do now?

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: I'll sit here and practice carving.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: If you pass this way again, I'll be glad if you drop my next load of work off with my family.

steps.speaker: Olaf Hradson
steps.text: That or bring me some food before I starve. Whichever.
Olaf hands you the map.

talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.text: Hey! I'm trying to carve and you're standing in my light! Move it!

talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.player: Olaf, I seem to have lost your map, can I have another?

talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.text: You lost the treasured map of Sven the Helmsman? How dare you!

talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.speaker: Olaf Hradson
talking-to-olaf-after-the-presents-have-.text: You'd best take better care of this one, or else!

entering-the-brine-rat-cavern-when-diggi.text: ...and fall into a dark and slimy pit!

entering-the-brine-rat-cavern-attempting.text: This 'wall' has some disks set into it showing a picture and some levers. I should try pulling the levers to see what happens.

entering-the-brine-rat-cavern-opening-th.text: You open the chest and the vengeful spirit of a fremennik captain appears!
You find a note in the chest...
